description: Web-based Software-Suite for DC Railway Simulation and Analysis: Architecture, Data Management and Visualization is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Islam El-Sayed, Bassam Mohamed. In this paper, a web-based application for DC Railways networks analysis is presented. The paper provides the guidelines to develop an integrated simulation framework containing different elements like server, databases, visual analytic tools using open-source software. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
